name: Touhou Puppet Dance Performance: Shard of Dreams - Genso Network Connection
summary:
The mod, Genso Network Connection, adds a new story apart from the original storyline, which is available from the start of the game. It features new maps, bosses, etc, all inspired by the fangame Shanghai.EXE Genso Network, which itself is based on the GBA game Series, Megaman Battle Network.

You been transported to an unknown world of cyber beings by a mysterious individual who requests your aid to help her. Do you accept her request and go off on a brand new adventure?

Author of Mod: Chabono
